lessons.title: The Law and the Common Good
lessons.context: A short passage on law, justice, and the common good.

paragraphs.dari: هدف اصلی قانون این است که حق هر انسان را حفظ کند.
paragraphs.en: The real purpose of law is to protect every person's right.

paragraphs.dari: وقتی قانون از ضعیفان حمایت می‌کند، تمام جامعه قوی می‌شود.
paragraphs.en: When law protects the weak, the whole society becomes strong.

paragraphs.dari: اعتماد مردم به محکمه‌ها اساس هر دموکراسی است.
paragraphs.en: People's trust in courts is the foundation of any democracy.

paragraphs.dari: وظیفه حکومت این است که ادارات را قوی و عادل نگه دارد.
paragraphs.en: It is the government's duty to keep institutions strong and just.

paragraphs.dari: جایی که عدالت باشد، پیشرفت خودش راه خود را می‌سازد.
paragraphs.en: Where there is justice, progress makes its own way by itself.

questions.question: What is the real purpose of law?
What happens when law protects the weak?
What is the foundation of any democracy, according to the passage?
What is the government's duty, according to the passage?
options: To keep institutions strong and just

lessons.title: Wisdom of the Ages
lessons.context: A capstone passage reflecting on wisdom, character, and civilization.

paragraphs.dari: هر تمدن نشانه‌هایی از حکمت خود را به جا می‌گذارد.
paragraphs.en: Every civilization leaves behind signs of its own wisdom.

paragraphs.dari: ملت‌هایی که قدر شخصیت و وجدان خود را می‌دانند، قرن‌ها باقی می‌مانند.
paragraphs.en: The nations that know the value of their character and conscience endure for centuries.

paragraphs.dari: دانش و فروتنی با هم انسان را واقعاً بزرگ می‌سازند.
paragraphs.en: Knowledge and humility together truly make a person great.

paragraphs.dari: نظام کائنات به ما یاد می‌آورد که ما بخش کوچک اما مهم این دنیا هستیم.
paragraphs.en: The universe's system reminds us that we are a small but important part of this world.

paragraphs.dari: به همین دلیل، هر نسل نو باید این حکمت را به پیش ببرد.
paragraphs.en: That is why every new generation should carry this wisdom forward.

questions.question: What does every civilization leave behind?
Which nations endure for centuries, according to the passage?
options: Those that know the value of character and conscience

questions.question: What truly makes a person great, according to the passage?
What should every new generation do, according to the passage?
